answer: In a decentralized AI agent economy, cryptographic proof-of-stake functions as a vital thread to bind network authority to economic capital. Each participating node must lock collateral behind a unique cryptographic pulse, ensuring every validating entity bears tangible weight. This financial barrier forces an attacker attempting a Sybil intrusion to accumulate prohibitive amounts of digital umber, rendering the cost of mass-generating fraudulent identities economically catastrophic and mathematically impractical.
